utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—when’s the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we know for sure it’s tonight, or has the time changed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good question — let’s confirm the time first so we don’t show up wrong.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I just want to make sure there’s enough room and I can get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure there’s plenty of room, and I can save you a spot near the front if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, thank you. I’ll text if I’m running late.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — once you have the title, send it over and I’ll get the discussion notes ready for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll send the title as soon as we decide. Thanks for getting the discussion notes ready!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — just send it over when you’ve decided, and I’ll have everything ready for the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you check the notes and tell me what time we’re meeting Thursday and which book we picked next?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m afraid I don’t have the notes in front of me, but I can check if you want. And I’m still bringing cookies to the book club—I’ve got that written down now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—please check the notes and tell me the Thursday time and next book when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds lovely — tell me which mystery novel it was, and I’ll try to make the next one.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll tell everyone the mystery novel and keep the book club plan moving. If anything changes, I’ll make sure the others know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll look out for the update and try to be there next time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It was a pretty quiet meeting, just a mystery novel and some tea. I can tell you the title if you’d like, and you’re welcome to join next time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that sounds cozy — I’d love to hear the title. And thanks, I just might join next time if I can make it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It was "The Paris Apartment"—nothing too heavy, just a good one for a small group. I’d be glad to see you there next time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest on book club yet, but I can ask around and let you know what I find out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re reading "The Winter Guest" this month. I can write down the meeting time too, if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—what time are we meeting? I’d love the details so I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus — I’m pretty sure it’s the mystery one, but I need to check the exact title first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know the title when you confirm it, and I can bring a few spare copies if needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check the exact title and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the notes and see what’s listed, then I’ll tell you exactly what’s there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana — that works for me. I’ll be a little late, but I can still help pick the next book and sort the meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the notes now and send you the listed book options and meeting spot so we can decide together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll round up snacks and make sure we have paper cups too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’m still watching for the time and exact location, and I’ll let you know as soon as Quinn sends it over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on the snacks and cups, and just send me the time and location when Quinn confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, 7 on Thursday works for me—I should be free by then. Please save me a spot, and I’ll catch up with you there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — 7 on Thursday sounds good, and I’ll save you a spot. Just bring whatever snacks you can round up, and we’ll catch up at book club.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll bring a few snacks and see you Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details as soon as I have the time and place confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks—I’ll keep an eye out for your update and bring notes in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll send it over as soon as I have the time and place nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll round up whatever snacks I can and make sure we’ve got the paper cups ready for tonight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, that sounds lovely — I haven’t heard any change, so it still looks like same place and same time tonight. I’m excited to see what new read they pick.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep everything on track and bring the snacks and paper cups tonight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds lovely — I’d like that. Which mystery novel was it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure which one yet, but I can check the details and let you know where and when the club’s meeting.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thank you — just let me know the details when you can, and I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to double-check the book club time and title?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard back yet, but I’m asking around now and I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—please do. I’ll wait for your update before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I’d like that—what time is the meeting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — it starts at 7 pm Thursday, and I can bring the spare chairs and a few extra copies if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus—that’s perfect. I’ll plan on 7 pm Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details and invite you along once I’ve got the time and place confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — that would be nice. I’ll look out for it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll send it as soon as I get the final time and place confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, 7 on Thursday works for me—I should be free by then. Please save me a spot, and I’ll catch up with you there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — I’ll save you a spot for Thursday at 7. See you then, and I’ll bring the meeting time note too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thank you—see you Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club! I’m writing it down now so I don’t forget the cookies again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, cookies are always appreciated — I can check on snacks and cups too if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — that’d be a big help. I’ve got the cookies written down, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t want to guess—let me check our notes first. If you remember the title options, send them and I’ll help narrow it down.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — I don’t remember the title options offhand, but I can check my notes and send them over. I just want to make sure we’ve got the right book and enough time to plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — send the options when you can, and I’ll help check the right book and timing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, I’m sorry I’ll probably be a bit late again, but I can still help sort out the next book and where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries, Dane — just send me the book title and I’ll check the meeting spot. We can sort it out from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send you the book title soon and we can pin down the meeting spot from there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—book club tonight. I think we’re still just doing the discussion, and whatever snacks you can round up sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll bring some snacks and a quick recap in case you want it. See you at book club tonight!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — a quick recap would help since I’ve probably missed a bit. See you tonight!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Leo — I’m happy to help with book club. What are we sorting out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — when’s the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We haven’t set it yet — let’s pick the next book and then I can help find a meeting time and spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm we’re still on for book club tonight, and which book we’re discussing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re still on for book club tonight, and once you confirm the title, I’ll have the discussion notes ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm the book title for me? And should I bring anything besides my notes?

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
